name: gta-enhanced-mod-lab
description: Inspect GTA V Enhanced assets, run repeatable checks, and manage scoped installation plans with verified backups and rollback.

interface.longDescription: Local tools and a researched guide for GTA V Enhanced. Inspect native assets, validate a Gen9 conversion, run negative fixtures, inspect the existing FiveM QA bridge, and apply or undo scoped file plans with backups. Gameplay and visual approval remain separate from static checks.
defaultPrompt: Revisa este mod para GTA V Enhanced antes de instalarlo.
Ejecuta las pruebas del laboratorio y muestra qué falta validar.
Prepara un plan de instalación con respaldo y rollback.
